title: South Florida nightlife guide: new openings, concerts, and candlelight plans
igCaption:
New openings and candlelight plans for South Florida this weekend.
Miami and Sunrise, price not listed

Sources: Miami’s Community News, Secret Miami, stupidDOPE

#MiamiNightlife #SouthFlorida #MiamiEvents #WeekendGuide

scenes.text: Need a weekend plan? Start with the Miami River, where a new Italian Riviera restaurant is on the calendar.
Mercante is opening on the Miami River in January 2027. Nicola Siervo is behind it, and the concept is Italian Riviera on the river.
scenes.caption: Mercante is opening on the Miami River in January 2027. Nicola Siervo is behind it, and the concept is Italian Riviera on the river.

scenes.text: Candlelight is spreading Christmas concerts across four venues this winter. The lineup includes Trinity Episcopal Cathedral, Eden Roc Miami Beach, First Church Miami, and Jungle Island.
scenes.caption: Candlelight is spreading Christmas concerts across four venues this winter. The lineup includes Trinity Episcopal Cathedral, Eden Roc Miami Beach, First Church Miami, and Jungle Island.

scenes.text: At Trinity Episcopal Cathedral, a string quartet plays Christmas music for about an hour, surrounded by flameless candles. The set includes White Christmas and music from The Polar Express. If you go, open NEAR and see who else caught the quartet.
scenes.caption: At Trinity Episcopal Cathedral, a string quartet plays Christmas music for about an hour, surrounded by flameless candles. The set includes White Christmas and music from The Polar Express. If you go, open NEAR and see who else caught the quartet.

scenes.text: The First Church Miami program starts with Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy and moves through Feliz Navidad, Last Christmas, and All I Want for Christmas Is You. One track, Love Is All Around from Love Actually, spent 15 weeks at No. 1 in the UK charts in 1994.

scenes.text: Jungle Island is also part of the lineup. The format stays the same with a string quartet, flameless candles, and Christmas music.
scenes.caption: Jungle Island is also part of the lineup. The format stays the same with a string quartet, flameless candles, and Christmas music.

scenes.text: Mercante or candlelight, which one gets your weekend? Night out stories are full of people you notice in passing and never meet, which is exactly the kind of thing NEAR makes a little less anonymous.
